newsArticles.summary:
The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP)  Annual Inventory Team 2025, composed of Commissioned and Non-Commissioned Officers from the BFP Regional Office IX in coordination with Representatives from the Commission on Audit, conducted a comprehensive inventory of personnel, property, and equipment at Titay Municipal Fire Station, Poblacion Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay.
The annual inventory of personnel, property, and equipment in the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Region IX ensures accountability and compliance with Commission on Audit (COA) guidelines. It verifies the proper recording, condition, and completeness of government-issued assets, including uniforms and equipment, while identifying shortages or damages for timely action. This process promotes transparency, efficiency, and operational readiness across the organization

newsArticles.title: 𝙏𝘼𝙂𝙐𝙍𝙊 𝘾𝙃𝘼𝙇𝙇𝙀𝙉𝙂𝙀 𝘽𝙔 𝙊𝙋𝙁𝙈-𝙕𝙎𝙋
newsArticles.summary:
|| 𝙏𝘼𝙂𝙐𝙍𝙊 𝘾𝙃𝘼𝙇𝙇𝙀𝙉𝙂𝙀 𝘽𝙔 𝙊𝙋𝙁𝙈-𝙕𝙎𝙋 ||
1722𝗛 - 25 𝗔𝗣𝗥𝗜𝗟 2025
𝐼𝑁 𝑃𝐻𝑂𝑇𝑂𝑆 || 𝗧𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗠𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗮𝗹 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝗲 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 personnel, under the supervision of 𝗙𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗦𝗣 𝗔𝗟𝗥𝗘𝗬 𝗧 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗕𝗢, 𝗕𝗙𝗣, Municipal Fire Marshal, overcame the strenuous 𝗧𝗔𝗚𝗨𝗥𝗢 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗟𝗟𝗘𝗡𝗚𝗘 (Testing Agility, Grit, Unity, Readiness in Operation) organized by the Office of the Provincial Fire Marshal, under the supervision of 𝗙𝗦𝗨𝗣𝗧 𝗝𝗔𝗖𝗤𝗨𝗘𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗘 𝗦 𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗘𝗚𝗔, 𝗗𝗦𝗖, Provincial Fire Marshal of Zamboanga Sibugay at Titay Municipal Fire Station, Poblacion Titay, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay. 
The challenge involves strenuous tasks like putting on personal protective equipment (PPE), hose deployment and coupling, ladder carrying, knot tying, victim drag, tire flipping, and sledgehammer use, all of which are intended to replicate the physically taxing and high-stress nature of fire and rescue operations. Through the series of physically taxing exercises, the firefighter-obstacle course assessed participants' strength, ability, and operational readiness. With tenacity and will, Titay MFS demonstrated their ability and held their ground.
𝐈𝐧 𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝/𝐨𝐫 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐞𝐬
𝐏𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥:
𝐓𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝐌𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐚𝐥 𝐅𝐢𝐫𝐞 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 🧑‍🚒👩‍🚒

newsArticles.title: ACCOMPLISHMENT ON ANTI-ILLEGAL DRUGS
TITAY MPS NEWS
newsArticles.summary:
At about 11:50 AM of September 10, 2025, personnel of Titay Municipal Police Station led by PMAJ ARNOLD A ESPARES, ACOP, facilitated the voluntary deposited of one (1) unrenewed firearm described as:
One (1) unit caliber .45mm Taurus (PT145 PRO – Serviceable) Pistol, with Serial Number: NEP97981, with one (1) magazine loaded with five (5) rounds of live ammunition of same caliber that expired on March 28, 2023.
The said firearm was deposited by one male individual, married, driver by occupation, and a resident of Barangay Poblacion Muslim, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay.
The said firearm is now under the custody of Titay MPS for proper disposition.
